info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Events Ticketing Tickets Refunds-v5-spec
info.description: The Event Ticket Refunds API enables users to retrieve details regarding ticket refunds for specific events. It allows event organizers and ticketing platforms to manage and provide information on refund statuses for purchased tickets. Users such as customer service representatives and event administrators can utilize this API to facilitate inquiries and resolve customer issues effectively. This endpoint serves as a vital tool to enhance user experience and streamline the refund process in the event ticketing industry.

get.summary: Retrieve refund details for a ticket.
get.description: Fetch the refund status and details related to a specific ticket. This endpoint provides information on whether a ticket is eligible for a refund and the amount that can be refunded.

requestBody.description: Request body for the ticket refund operation, which specifies the details necessary to process a refund request for a previously purchased ticket.
